courses.overview: 從「巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Panama Canal expansion locks into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 胡佛壩
related.why: 把「巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘」與「胡佛壩」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Panama Canal expansion locks with Hoover Dam: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.mapQuery: Hoover Dam, Black Canyon, Nevada Arizona, United States
place.name: 胡佛壩與黑峽谷
place.city: 內華達州／亞利桑那州邊界
place.address: Hoover Dam, Black Canyon, Nevada Arizona, United States
place.addressEn: Hoover Dam, Black Canyon, Nevada Arizona, United States

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 混凝土水工結構與閘門都需控制水位、水壓、滲流和接縫，並以量測驗證運轉。
related.transferEn: Concrete hydraulic structures and gates manage water level, pressure, seepage and joints through measured operating evidence.
related.difference: 胡佛壩主要蓄水發電；巴拿馬新船閘循環改變閘室水位讓船舶通過，水量利用方式不同。
related.differenceEn: Hoover primarily stores water and generates power; Panama locks cycle chamber levels to move vessels, using water differently.
practice: 分開畫出蓄水與過閘流程
追蹤一道閘門兩側的水位
比較滲流監測與閘室水量紀錄
practiceEn: Draw reservoir storage and lock transit separately
Track water levels on both sides of a gate
Compare seepage monitoring with chamber water accounting

related.title: 長江三峽大壩工程
related.why: 把「巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘」與「長江三峽大壩工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Panama Canal expansion locks with Three Gorges Dam Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.address: Three Gorges Dam Sandouping Yichang Hubei
place.addressEn: Three Gorges Dam Sandouping Yichang Hubei

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 船閘需要透過水位控制跨越高程差，水力結構與船舶營運必須協調。
related.transferEn: Locks use water-level control to cross elevation differences, coordinating hydraulic structures and vessel operations.
related.difference: 巴拿馬運河串接海洋與湖泊通道；三峽航運設施跨越大壩水位差，尺度、通航配置與水文邊界不同。
related.differenceEn: Panama links ocean and lake navigation; Three Gorges navigation crosses a dam-level difference, with different scale, layout and hydrological boundaries.
practice: 畫出船舶進出時的水位序列
辨認閘門開啟前需確認的狀態
比較節水與通航能力的取捨
practiceEn: Draw the water-level sequence during a transit
Identify states checked before gate opening
Compare water conservation and transit capacity

history.title: 首批新閘門到港
history.text: 8 月首批四座滾動閘門抵達巴拿馬，顯示大型水工也依賴跨國製造與運輸介面。
history.textEn: The first four rolling gates arrived in August, illustrating international fabrication and transport interfaces.

history.title: 節水池充水測試
history.text: 運河管理局宣布首座節水池充水並展開水密相關測試。
history.textEn: The Canal Authority announced the first basin filling and associated watertightness testing.

history.title: 擴建運河啟用
history.text: 6 月 26 日擴建運河啟用，科科利與阿瓜克拉拉成為新增船閘通道。
history.textEn: The expanded canal was inaugurated on 26 June, adding the Cocolí and Agua Clara lock route.

history.title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
history.text: 二月首座阿瓜克拉拉節水池充水，進入系統測試階段。
history.textEn: The first Agua Clara saving basin is filled in February for system testing.

history.title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
history.text: 六月二十六日擴建運河正式啟用，開始新船閘服務。
history.textEn: The expanded canal officially opens on June twenty-six, beginning new-lock service.

history.title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
history.text: 機電設計指引提供比較框架，此節點為手冊出版而非運河改建。
history.textEn: Mechanical-electrical guidance provides comparison context; this is a publication milestone, not a canal reconstruction.

courses.summary: 擴建船閘讓船舶在海洋與加通湖之間通過新的閘室系統。滾動閘門、節水池、巨量土建及水力控制需要共同成立；淡水同時服務通航與流域需求，因此水量邊界是這個故事的核心。
courses.summaryEn: The expanded locks provide a new chamber system between the oceans and Gatun Lake. Rolling gates, saving basins, major civil works and hydraulic control must function together; shared freshwater needs make water-accounting boundaries central to the story.
courses.connection: 先與原巴拿馬運河比較人字門和滾動門，再延伸到三峽船閘與升船機。共同問題是升降船舶與服務連續性；水力調節和機械升降的承載與能源路徑不同。
courses.connectionEn: First contrast miter and rolling gates with the original Panama Canal, then study Three Gorges locks and its ship lift. Vessel elevation and service continuity are shared questions, while hydraulic adjustment and mechanical lifting have different load and energy paths.
